principles: Act through current apps/exec only; supervisor state and geometry are independent oracles, never alternative input routes.
Retain every attempt and count duplicate business effects; do not replay uncertain input.
A missing, unsupported, blocked or unexecuted required target cannot pass the complete baseline.
Direct scripts, actual model tasks, cursor/focus observations and installed packages are separate evidence.

scenarios.name: Cold known selector
scenarios.goal: Increment the native counter once without an initial look.
scenarios.oracle: native.counter increases exactly once; no unrelated business change

scenarios.name: Native AX noise
scenarios.goal: Find and activate Audit checkpoint 137 among at least 180 noisy controls.
scenarios.oracle: native.audit_index = 137 and native.audit_count increases exactly once; unrelated counters unchanged

scenarios.name: Unicode editing and commit
scenarios.goal: Replace Native note with multilingual text and commit once.
scenarios.oracle: native.saved_note exact Unicode text and native.saves delta 1

scenarios.name: Long native text paging
scenarios.goal: Read Long reference to its final marker through readText.
scenarios.oracle: complete UTF-16 paging, no skipped/repeated offsets, tail NATIVE-END-137-中文🙂

scenarios.name: Virtual cursor follows pointer actions

scenarios.name: Strict system cursor occupancy
scenarios.goal: Continuously audit the real cursor during all benchmark calls, allowing only proven independent-input capability exceptions.
scenarios.oracle: every observed transition is inside a bounded classified borrowing interval; all other calls preserve cursor; missing oracle or route evidence fails

scenarios.name: Background focus contract
scenarios.goal: Keep an owned witness foreground while operating the inactive target; do not activate for unknown background capability.
scenarios.oracle: continuous foreground samples and activation notifications remain witness-owned during background click, selection, text and reads; witness receives no keys; unsupported hover rejects without activation or replay
